purpose: Recompute the bounded primitive sequential-policy comparison only after integrating branch-labelled post-flux relations, linear GF(2) homology, and the verified expanded public charge decoder.
epistemic_role: Corrected computation contract. This registration authorizes structural and resource preflight only; it does not authorize reporting policy risk until every invariance and decoder-membership gate passes.

unchanged_scientific_question.first_actions: All 32 syndrome-faithful red-X corrections for each flux syndrome.
unchanged_scientific_question.terminal_rule: The hidden physical error union the first correction is an immediate logical loss when it winds.
unchanged_scientific_question.second_channel: For N active stars and C independent even-parity components, P(Y=y|E,A)=2^(C-N) on the affine support and zero elsewhere.
unchanged_scientific_question.second_actions: The 4 x 4 blue/green homology-sector pairs of the exact affine charge-chain quotient.
policy_matrix: public first action with exact continuation

corrected_representation.post_flux_relations: Infer BranchPostFluxRelations from actual two-step union paths and retain the stable physical branch id for every relation.
corrected_representation.effective_error_representative: For every supported Y, construct a deterministic branch chain using a stable-branch-id spanning forest of each relation component.
corrected_representation.homology: Compute exact loss with the validated linear branch_chain_sector period cochain; the legacy component-level Boolean winding collector is forbidden.
corrected_representation.public_second_stage: Decode unit physical branch weights with the verified private-auxiliary expanded PyMatching graph and map its fault ids back to complete physical branches.
corrected_representation.exact_second_stage: Use the exhaustive four equal homology classes per colour as the exact action quotient.

representative_invariance_gate.statement: For every nonterminal (E,A) branch and each colour, let H_rel be the relation-subgraph branch-incidence map and W_rel the two-bit branch period cochain. Require W_rel c = 0 for every c in ker(H_rel).
representative_invariance_gate.interpretation: All branch-resolved effective-error representatives with the same measured Y then have identical homology; the deterministic spanning-forest representative cannot silently choose the logical sector.
representative_invariance_gate.additional_boundary_check: For every supported Y, the constructed effective branch chain must have exactly boundary Y on the active charge vertices and zero boundary elsewhere.
representative_invariance_gate.fail_closed_rule: If any relation-cycle kernel element has nontrivial period, or any constructed representative has the wrong boundary, censor every policy-risk output and preserve the failing witness.

required: the original second-channel normalization, anti-leak, terminal/nonterminal counts, and streamed-contribution counts are reproduced
every post-flux relation has unique actual-path branch provenance and forgetting labels reproduces the endpoint relation partition
the representative-invariance kernel and supported-Y boundary gates pass for every nonterminal branch and both colours
the linear branch quotient has exactly four equal sectors per colour
every expanded public correction belongs to the exhaustive affine chains, has the requested boundary, and has its validated period-cochain sector
policy keys contain only decoder-visible observations and known prior actions
posterior mass is conserved through immediate and continued branches
future-aware exact risk is no larger than myopic-first exact-continuation risk, which is no larger than the matched public-first comparator when their action sets are nested
public-first exact-continuation risk is no larger than public fixed-two-stage risk
no stochastic, larger-lattice, noisy-measurement, LER, threshold, or scalable-optimality claim is introduced
validation.preflight_stop_rule: Stop before final policy computation on any source, topology, provenance, kernel-invariance, boundary, quotient, decoder-membership, observation-boundary, normalization, resource, or risk-ordering prerequisite failure.

resource_projection_amendment.reason: The first corrected preflight multiplied the complete one-time branch-representative precompute by the O2/O0 transition ratio and by four priors, even though the registered policy implementation caches each hidden (E,A,Y) transition loss before observation/prior aggregation.
resource_projection_amendment.corrected_projection: Add one measured corrected branch/channel precompute to the source-frozen original R4.5 conservative four-prior streaming projection. Do not multiply branch representative construction by observation multiplicity or prior count.
resource_projection_amendment.unchanged_limits: The 30-minute total and 4-GiB memory guards are unchanged; no scientific acceptance criterion or risk result is altered.

final_computation_activation.prerequisite: The corrected preflight passes every channel, provenance, kernel-invariance, representative-boundary, affine-membership, quotient, expanded-public, and resource gate.
final_computation_activation.aggregation: Cache each hidden (E,A,Y) terminal/sector transition once. For each observable history (O,A,Y), sum posterior evidence over the sixteen joint blue/green sector labels; exact continuation selects the maximum-evidence label and public continuation uses the expanded unit-weight MWPM label.
final_computation_activation.deterministic_ties: First-action ties within absolute risk tolerance 1e-12 are resolved by the smallest physical action mask.
final_computation_activation.stop_rule: Write one complete four-prior O0/O2 policy matrix and stop. Censor interpretation if mass conservation, observation-only keys, source hashes, or any registered risk ordering fails.
